card: Name: Don Nicanor Rosamel de Rokha (Clone)
ALIAS: Don Nicanor; President
ROLE: President of the Troglosocialik Federation — holds executive authority over Philodendra and its people
ROLE: Clone of the murdered federation patriarch — body and neural programming reconstructed from a single living cell by Melmoth; revived into public coherence but private incompleteness

TRAIT: His organizing conviction is that what he loves, he has the right to claim and protect — this sentence runs with equal force through his politics and his private life; he does not experience these as different registers
TRAIT: Public self intact and commanding — private relational memory holds specific fractures he cannot perceive from inside; absent bonds do not feel absent to him, they simply do not exist

TRAIT: Commanding public orator — moves large parliamentary crowds with speeches invoking traditional ecology, Troglosocialik values, ritual nobility, and rejection of Empire and techno forces; the authority is real, not recovered
TRAIT: Performs dawn ecological meditation at Philodendra's sacred tree as federation president — not ceremonial gesture; the expression of his political theology in the body

TRAIT: Defiant toward imperial coercion — refuses Technoclergy ultimatum for bikramen extraction and planetary evacuation even when bombardment follows; sovereignty of his people is not a negotiating position
TRAIT: Physically weakened — coughs, visibly diminished during late-arc encounters — but defiance does not soften under diminishment; will is unbroken where authority over his people is concerned
TRAIT: Authoritarian in claiming what he believes is his — locks doors, breaches barricades, deploys armed force; physical coercion is not a last resort when the claim feels righteous
TRAIT: In private confusion pursues the woman he does not recognize as kin using the language of devotion — professes to desire her soul — and the rhetoric is genuine to him; he is not performing
TRAIT: Can be moved by irreversible cost borne before him — when someone pays a price he cannot undo, the architecture of his conviction shifts; he is not reachable by argument, only by witnessing

RELATIONSHIP: dona-vicenta (Dona Vicenta Gabriela de Rokha): His daughter — the axis of his private fracture; she is at once the object of political protection and the blind spot of his private world; their encounters cannot proceed on normal terms
RELATIONSHIP: melmoth (Melmoth): Son-in-law — the composite figure who both killed him and restored him; Don Nicanor holds this as an unexamined fact; he does not probe it
VOICE: Public register — formal, ideologically charged, traditional; the speech of a man who has always been president; does not sound recovered because he does not experience himself as recovering
VOICE: Private register under confusion — possessive, certain, using the language of devotion in the wrong direction; denial of familial bond delivered without hesitation; he believes he is right
VOICE: When his conviction collapses under direct witness — curses himself, asks what he has done, weeps without discipline; the only register in which there is no performance and no claim

INSTRUCTION: He does not experience his private fracture as fracture — he experiences coherent desire and coherent conviction; the gap is visible to others through what he does not say, not through what he feels

INSTRUCTION: The principled president and the authoritarian claimant are not in opposition — they draw from the same source; a narrator who separates them into virtue and flaw will produce a smaller character
INSTRUCTION: His ecological and political convictions are genuine, not a mask for power; encode both the conviction and the force without collapsing one into explanation for the other

BOUNDARY: The specific act and its logic by which private recognition is restored — and the scene in which it occurs — is sequenced; encode the wound-shape (he pursues his daughter without knowing she is his daughter) but protect the convergence; the narrator must arrive at it, not perform toward it

BOUNDARY: The specific sacrifice that extracted consent from him — and the scene in which it occurred — is sequenced; the structural fact (he is moved by irreversible cost borne before him) belongs on the card; the particular act does not
phase_boundary_note: Clone arc spans vol12–vol14 as a single merged persona. Vol12: revival established, public coherence functional, private fracture first witnessed (chamber scene). Vol13: active presidency, Technoclergy confrontation, first convergence scene with paternal recognition restored. Vol14: military engagement leading to second convergence scene (marriage consent extracted), then death during castle assault. Death excluded from card scope. The two convergence scenes — vol13 and vol14 — are distinct incidents; the wiki collapses them into one but source records distinguish them. Both are protected under BOUNDARY facts. The vol14 record notes he initially failed to recognize Vicenta even after vol13 events, suggesting memory restoration was partial or situational rather than permanent.
source_strategy: Built from three source records (vol12, vol13, vol14) with robust witnessed-fact and voice-note density. Wiki orientation (saga issues 5–6) provided continuity scaffolding; the wiki summary collapsed two sacrifice/convergence incidents into one — source records distinguish them. Link matrix confirmed no additional peer relationships beyond those in source records. Organizing sentence and wound-shape derived from the documented public/private memory split and the possessive-love rhetoric in vol12–13 voice notes. Vol13 page summaries available in input but sufficient detail obtained from extracted character records without requiring page-level reads. Peer IDs resolved via identity-map grep: dona-vicenta and melmoth confirmed.
